title: Arboresce context, evaluation, attestation and channel v1 contract definitions
description: Library only: select a named definition. Parsed-value constraints do not establish canonical hashes, exact reference/count joins, current authority, signature validity, transactional transitions, token counts or complete delivery.

observation_core.description: Exactly the seven canonical observation fields; the complete existing observation definition retains all source-kind and grounding constraints.

compiled_content.description: Chunk scalar bounds only. Canonical UTF-8 segmentation, actual byte caps, concatenation and digest equality require semantic verification.

evaluation_core.description: Finite validity/outcome constraints are structural. Complete suite/result identity joins, exact length/count arithmetic and required-case policy remain semantic checks.

attestation_core.description: Signature encoding only. Canonical point/scalar decoding, subgroup checks, exact signing bytes, trusted registration and current eligibility require qualified semantic verification.

channel_event.description: Static reachable-state minima are enforced. Exact generation increment, previous-event linkage, target preservation, historical rollback ordering and all identity joins remain semantic checks.

read_context.description: Decoded exact GET query context only. Route equality, duplicate/unknown raw query keys and single percent-decoding require transport admission.
